description: CSS GCPM running elements: position: running(name) plus content: element(name) in @page margin boxes. The header is markup (a logo image, a bold coloured name) laid out once and stamped on every page, alongside a counter footer in another slot.
visual_assertions: Every page carries the Northwind header at the top-left, with its logo image and the bold blue company name, inside the top margin and clear of the body text.
Every page carries the red CONFIDENTIAL stamp at the top-right of the same band.
Every page carries a bottom-right 'Page N of M' footer with the final total.
The header appears once per page, not a second time as body content on page 1.
ORPHANHEADER never appears: it is running() under a name no margin box asks for.
